AFTER YOUR SCHEDULED DEPARTURE

After your planned leave time,
here is what you will see.

HappyLulu helps you avoid doing the math yourself: it shows how long it has been since your scheduled departure and how much time remains until the two-hour reference time.

Mac and Windows 1.5.13 use the same time thresholds. The display follows your calculated scheduled departure; it does not measure time actually worked.

6:29 PM

Before extra time appears

Less than 30 minutes have passed since the scheduled 6:00 PM departure. There are 91 minutes until the 8:00 PM reference time.

6:30 PM

30 minutes in progress

Elapsed time appears as soon as 30 minutes have passed. The two-hour reference time is 90 minutes away.

6:31 PM

31 minutes in progress

The displayed count starts at your scheduled departure. There are 89 minutes until the reference time.

+2 hours

Two hours after scheduled departure

If your planned departure is 6:00 PM, the reference time is 8:00 PM. HappyLulu shows the remaining minutes before then and marks the time as reached at 8:00 PM.

Your schedule

Half days and last Fridays are included

Scheduled departure uses your recorded arrival and work/break settings. A half day is four hours; a last Friday shortens a regular workday by two hours.

A guide

No arrival record, no notice

The after-departure guide stays hidden when today has no arrival record or is marked as a day off.

This timing guide does not verify that you worked or approve meal or wage payments. It is personal reference information, not an official attendance record.
